summary: Limited-time Deepgram promotion: every $1 of paid Flux TTS usage earns $1 in bonus credits, up to $500 per eligible project. Open to new and existing Pay-As-You-Go and Growth projects (Enterprise excluded); a valid payment method is required. Runs Sep 15 – Dec 31, 2026; bonus credits never expire and stack with the standard $200 signup credit.
claim_steps: Use a Deepgram Pay-As-You-Go or Growth project with a valid payment method on file.
Spend paid credits on Flux TTS between Sep 15 and Dec 31, 2026 (usage paid with promotional credits does not qualify).
Bonus credits are granted to the project, typically within 1 week.

social_proof.text: The Promotion begins at 12:00 a.m. Pacific Time on September 15, 2026 and ends at 11:59 p.m. Pacific Time on December 31, 2026. Up to $500 in Bonus Credits per Eligible Project.
